no_source_imagery.rationale: The paraphrase uses direct descriptions of document origin and handling and retains procurement entities. No source discipline names or source-specific metaphors remain; handling histories and handoffs describe the target records and their transfers.

no_verdict_language.rationale: Neither text evaluates the procedure as ordinary, novel, creative, unorthodox, merely formalization or a material departure, or claims that it adds or lacks a new warrant. The paraphrase describes behavior and evidential limits.
